results.title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
results.original_title: バッド・ルーテナント：トウキョウ
results.overview: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.

results.title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
results.original_title: Le Journal d'une femme de chambre
results.overview: A young Romanian woman living in France works for a French family and joins a theatre company who are adapting Octave Mirbeau's The Diary of a Chambermaid.

results.title: Gajab Raat
results.overview: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

results.title: Our Son
results.overview: Two childless married couples raise an unexpected son from an illicit affair between the two households. Amidst the chaos that follows a paternity reveal, the two wives take parenting into their own hands.

results.title: Lapland War
results.overview: Young soldier Heikki fights on the Karelian Isthmus alongside his friend Pauli. Arvo, recently released from prison, joins the company, challenging the others' views on war and duty with his worldview. The ceasefire raises hopes of returning home, but it soon becomes clear that Finland must turn against its former German allies in Lapland. At the same time, Saara, who works as a German interpreter in Rovaniemi, must choose her future: stay in Finland or flee to Germany with her beloved, Major Duisberg.

results.title: Little Thomas
results.overview: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

results.title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
results.overview: The school’s cool, prince-like heroine has never questioned her role—until a fellow “Prince” enters her life and sees her as more than a hero, awakening feelings she’s never faced before.

results.title: Pikkuli and Starlight Reindeer
results.overview: When the adults of Sunny Moor Forest begin arguing, the magical star atop the Christmas tree flickers and dies, leading them to cancel Christmas. Young Pikkuli and his friends embark on a daring adventure to find the mythical Starlight Reindeer. Along their journey, they face challenges, meet magical creatures, and discover that the true magic of Christmas lies not in the star but in their love and unity.

results.title: Yaga
results.overview: In this psychological descent into ancient witchcraft, power, and seduction, two investigators unlock dark secrets after questioning a mysterious professor about a missing student.

results.title: The 3 Killer Pigs
results.overview: A local farmer is desperate and does the unthinkable in his attempt to get his precious livestock back. A blood oath is put in place when the killer pigs make their way back to where their nightmare began. Darkness shrouds the farmhouse and its occupants when the three piggies come home.

results.title: Udta Teer
results.overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

results.title: Love Language
results.overview: After a failed engagement, a woman discovers a talent for writing wedding vows, but her growing success and new romance are complicated when she’s hired to write vows for her former college flame’s wedding.

results.title: Nine Mountains: Paraghost
results.overview: Gongneum, driven to the brink of death by school violence, awakens from a three-year coma. Following Yeosunji, a shaman who claims to know about her memories and her family's whereabouts, she heads to Ahopsan Forest. There she encounters the bullies, including their ringleader Kim Gayoung, and confronts memories of her forgotten past. Inspired by the real Ahopsan Forest in Busan, the dense bamboo grove becomes a space suspended between reality and the otherworld, where spirits of those who died unnatural deaths wander and "parasitic spirits" — restless souls that inhabit other bodies—begin to consume the forest.

results.title: Children of The Wicker Man
results.overview: Fifty years after The Wicker Man, director Robin Hardy’s lost papers resurface, prompting his sons Justin and Dominic to explore the legacy of the cult classic, and their father. Together, they uncover the truth behind Robin’s role in the film and confront the complexities of independent filmmaking, family, and myth.

results.title: Udumbanchola Vision
results.overview: When album designer Midhun takes over a struggling local TV channel, he uncovers a deadly rivalry behind its downfall. Using secrets and manipulation, he rises to power, but his ambition quickly turns to greed. Just as he dominates the industry, a dangerous international threat emerges.

results.title: Abang: Path to Return
results.overview: Orphaned at a young age, Uwais and his younger sister, Hasnah, are taken in by their uncle Usop, a loan shark who raises them within an illegal moneylending syndicate. While Uwais struggles to hold on to his remaining moral compass, Hasnah spirals deeper into gambling and self-destruction. Under the influence of the powerful Haji Daud, they become trapped in a dangerous criminal network, forcing Uwais to confront rival gangs, buried loyalties and the system that shaped his life. Amid violence and betrayal, he must decide who he truly is and what he is willing to sacrifice to reclaim his identity and redefine the meaning of family.

results.title: A Talent for Murder
results.overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

results.title: Etude of Life
results.overview: In the war-torn Europe of 1944, a woman sees her life fall to pieces as she is forced to choose between her treacherous husband and an enemy officer.
